# Curbpack reference

Use the reference documentation when you need exact commands, configuration fields, pack formats, or generated outputs.

* [CLI](cli.md) — commands, flags, aliases, and exit codes
* [Configuration](configuration.md) — `.curbpack.json`, pack selection, and environment variables
* [Packs](packs.md) — pack schema, rule fields, check types, and composition
* [Outputs](outputs.md) — generated files, formats, and locations

For an overview of how Curbpack works, see [Concepts](../concepts/README.md).
